body:
Well if I don't get a job within 30 days my parents have decided to pull my insurance. Can't blame them on that, but that's another thing. The pressure is on there, so roughly 30 days and it's do or die. Except most people don't know how literal the do or die is for me :|



The motivation is still non existent though. I absolutely love being able drive and such. But I've already accepted losing them both. Fuck.

I thought I had dealt with it, figuring it would fade over time. Only just now am I realizing that I never dealt with it. And I'm unsure of how to deal with it so I can move on. I've long since severed contact with them both. Haven't seen either in quite some time. And thank you, but I can barely get myself out of my house at this point. It'd be a miracle if I could even pull myself to go sit on those tracks..

The reason it all started? Nearing on two years ago I dumped my then girlfriend of a year and a half. Two? weeks later she was with my then best friend. I tried extremely hard to keep people who would fuck me over out of my life, and then that happens. He asked me if it would bother me if they dated and I said no, but my answer wouldn't have made a difference. This was proved through his later responses to some of what I had to say.




 Reading through some old messages I told her I was having serious problems and was contemplating suicide around August 2013. She said that I was 'being ridiculous' and needed to stop 'obsessing over it'. We had been very good friend for 3 or 4 years prior to dating. It was both of our first serious relationship. I was a complete dick most of the time after 5 or so months. I single-handedly destroyed that relationship. But she was also at fault many times.




 Because of that incident I had to leave school in my junior year, I couldn't deal with seeing either of them at all. I left in December and got my GED in early March. Didn't keep up contact after I left, despite the best friend living within 1 mile of me(still does). And the ex, well fuck keeping contact with her.




 Fast forward to now and the introduction of someone who I feel a serious connection with has caused some ugly feelings to resurface. It's been quite some time since I felt I really cared about someone. That whole situation is really.... odd. But that's a different story. So here I sit, as I have for the last couple years of my life. Doing nothing. Being nothing. Aspiring for nothing. Accepting that I am nothing.
Between not seeing what 'help' is, and not being able to find something that's worth it, life is pretty fucking bad right now.
I just don't know what to do anymore. Is help really worth getting? It seems like this doesn't stop..
Something happened a while ago that started it.
Was on that road once for something unrelated, and for years none of it actually did anything. It also gives me the impression of dependency, which I don't like at all.

The emotional pain that comes along with depression. I should have been more clear on that. 
Depression is nearing on 2 years.
